scope: Single node, localhost, in-process SQLite. Not a distributed measurement.

summary.interpretation: Latency past the throughput ceiling is queueing on the single writer, which is the known consequence of the single-node MVP (Q-03 deferred).

note_on_variance: This run measured ~1,220 req/s where an earlier run on the same code measured ~1,750. Checked rather than assumed: the pre-change commit re-measured at 1,219 on this machine, and disabling the rate limiter changed nothing, so the difference is the host, not the code. Treat the ceiling as roughly 1,200-1,800 req/s on one node and the concurrency figure as the stable result: p99 stays under 50ms to about 25 connections in both.

rate_limits_active_during_measurement.note: Set high so the limiter runs on every request without shaping the load. Measured with it disabled too; the difference was within noise.
